<section class="r-lab" data-r-lab="03_window_results" aria-label="Read and check the saved window results">
<div class="r-lab-heading"><span class="r-lab-badge">Run R</span><h3>Read and check the saved window results</h3></div>
<p class="r-lab-note">Reads the data-only RDS and recalculates selection and the empirical probability from its 500 saved searches.</p>
<label for="r-code-03_window_results">Editable R code</label>
<textarea id="r-code-03_window_results" class="r-lab-code" spellcheck="false" rows="10">results &lt;- readRDS(&quot;cache/climwin/recovered_search_data.rds&quot;)
x &lt;- results$main$Dataset
eligible &lt;- subset(x, WindowOpen - WindowClose &gt;= 2)
best &lt;- eligible[which.min(eligible$deltaAICc), ]
print(best[, c(&quot;WindowOpen&quot;, &quot;WindowClose&quot;, &quot;deltaAICc&quot;, &quot;ModelBeta&quot;)])
null &lt;- results$randomised$deltaAICc
print(c(randomisations = length(null), exceedances = sum(null &lt;= best$deltaAICc),
        plus_one_p = (1 + sum(null &lt;= best$deltaAICc))/(length(null) + 1)))
validation &lt;- readRDS(&quot;cache/climwin/recovery_audit_results.rds&quot;)
print(validation$temporal_validation)
</textarea>
